newsitem.title: USA: United Meridian completes credit line.
newsitem.headline: United Meridian completes credit line.

text.p: United Meridian Corp said on Wednesday it completed arrangements for a $300 million global credit facility.
The new facility was expanded to include the company's international assets for the first time, United Meridian said.

The five-year revolver will be available as necessary to support the company's capital spending program, including accelerated development activity and future acquisitions, the company said. The initial borrowing base has been set at $275 million.

The underwriting bank group is led by the Chase Manhattan Bank as administrative agent and arranger, Morgan Guaranty Trust as syndication agent, NationsBank and Societe Generale as co-documentation agents, and Wells Fargo, Banque Paribas, and Colorado National as co-agents.
United Meridian intends to work with Chase and Morgan to syndicate a portion of this loan to several other prominent energy-lending institutions within the next 30 days.
